VinCheck.metaTitle: VIN check in Latvia | how a car history check works | PROVIN
VinCheck.metaDescription: VIN check before you buy a used car: what a VIN is, what a car history report shows, and why you also need a listing audit, not just a data dump.
VinCheck.h1: VIN check before you buy a car
VinCheck.lead: A VIN is the 17-character factory identifier. It lets us pull registries, service history and contradictions in the advert. PROVIN does not stop at a raw printout: we compare sources and say what that means for this car.
VinCheck.whatBody: A VIN check is a car history check by identification number: mileage, accidents, theft, registry records and, when available, official dealer service history. That is not the same as one database PDF. Sources only overlap in part, and listing photos often say more than a table row.
VinCheck.whyTitle: Why one car history report is not enough
VinCheck.whyBody: A standard report shows what was entered into a system. Sellers know that and often pick cars with a thin digital trail. So beside the VIN check, PROVIN reads the listing and the weak points of that model. If you have a listing link, add it to the order.
VinCheck.howTitle: How a check works at PROVIN
VinCheck.howBody: Enter the VIN or plate on the home page, choose MINI or AUDITS, and add the listing if you have it. MINI fits a car already used in Latvia. AUDITS is the deeper check for an import: international databases, dealer systems and auction archives when they exist. Results usually arrive in 24-72h, with a short call after the report.
VinCheck.findBody: A VIN is 17 characters. You usually see it at the bottom left of the windscreen from inside the car, on the driver door frame, or on the registration document. Listings often show it in the text or a photo. If the advert has no VIN, ask the seller before you travel to view the car. A car history check is not possible without a VIN or plate.
VinCheck.historyTitle: What a car history check means
VinCheck.historyBody: A car history check by VIN gathers what registries and databases have on that car: mileage, accidents, theft, country changes and, when available, official dealer service records. That helps you spot contradictions with the advert. It is not the same as seeing the car in person or a workshop diagnosis. If a source has no data, we say so. We do not invent it.
VinCheck.vsDecoderTitle: VIN check and the free VIN decoder
VinCheck.vsDecoderBody: The free VIN decoder reads the manufacturer, country and, for many makes, the model or year. That helps you compare the VIN in the advert with the car. A VIN check and a car history check go further: registries, service history and the listing. The decoder is the first step. If the car is a real candidate, next comes MINI or AUDITS.
VinCheck.latviaTitle: A car already in Latvia versus an import
VinCheck.latviaBody: If the car has been in Latvia for several years, local registries (CSDD, insurers, the roadworthiness test) often cover the main points. MINI is usually enough then. If the car was imported recently, the local trail is short. Then you need foreign databases, dealer systems and auction archives when they exist. That is AUDITS. We pick sources by make and origin, not one fixed list for every car.
VinCheck.homeTitle: VIN check and car history check
VinCheck.homeBody: If you need a VIN check or a car history check before you buy, start with the VIN and the listing link. Next we explain what the check includes and which package to pick.
VinCheck.homeMore: If you first want the difference, read the <vinPage>guide to a VIN check and a car history check</vinPage>.

VinDecoder.metaTitle: Free VIN decoder: manufacturer, country and year | PROVIN
VinDecoder.metaDescription: Free VIN decoder: manufacturer, country of manufacture and possible model year from the VIN. History, mileage and listing analysis in the PROVIN audit.
VinDecoder.title: VIN decoder
VinDecoder.lead: Check a car by its Latvian plate or 17-character VIN. With a plate you see the registry data (make, model, year, engine, inspection) and the start of the VIN - compare it with the VIN in the advert to make sure it is genuine and belongs to this car. With a VIN you get the manufacturer, country and, for many makes, model and year. Free, no sign-up.

HomeFreeTools.title: Three things you can do
HomeFreeTools.lead: Start with a free check. Order the full audit only if the car is really worth it.
HomeFreeTools.vinBody: Enter a Latvian registration number to see the make, model, year, engine and inspection date right away. Enter a VIN to get the manufacturer, country of origin and, for many makes, the model and year. Free, no sign-up.
